key_insight: pyDOF is a Python library that automates the constrained design of customizable discrete forward and inverse filters for physical-space signal processing.
engineering_relevance: It gives CFD and broader engineering users a flexible way to generate low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and user-defined filters with automatically computed coefficients and exportable text output.
method: Uses constrained optimization to shape discrete filter transfer functions.
Supports symmetry, monotonicity, positivity, value-fixing, and gradient-smoothing constraints.
Includes adaptive stencil selection and van Cittert inverse-filter design with user-set reconstruction order.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a software framework and design capabilities, but does not provide quantitative benchmark results or accuracy comparisons.
watch_item: Filter quality and stability will depend on constraint choices, stencil selection, and inverse-filter order, so users should validate settings for each application.
paper_title: pyDOF: a Python library for the design of discrete forward and inverse filters
